cap: White four-rail fenced pastures and a tree-lined drive leading to the house and barns on the 20-acre property
Country home with arched windows, double front doors and a triple garage, set on a wide lawn
Living room with a vaulted ceiling, gas fireplace and a tall arched window
Oak kitchen with a large island, built-in wall oven and an eating area by the bay windows
Family room with a gas fireplace and French doors, open to the kitchen
Large primary bedroom with a tray ceiling and windows over the fenced paddocks
Fenced in-ground pool and hot tub beside the house, with the barn and pastures beyond
Landscaped patio with seating next to the pool, looking toward the horse barn
Back of the house with a patio off the French doors and a large lawn
Horse barn with a wide centre aisle, box stalls, a tack room and a loft
